Name: Brunette Claire
Author: flyspies
Description:
This mod contains the portrait and sprites for Claire, the Stardew Valley Expanded character, recolored to have dark hair instead of red. 

There are folders for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] replacing Claire's original sprites and portraits. Save the originals somewhere else, then extract the Brunette Claire mod and find the folder labeled Stardew Valley Expanded. Paste this inside your -Stardew Valley Expanded--(whatever update you have) and it will replace her sprites and portraits. 

There is also a folder for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url] which recolors all of Claire's seasonal outfits and provides sprites in the slightly cuter style, which will replace the original portraits and sprites once you combine the "assets" folder from Brunette Claire mod and Seasonal Cute Characters SVE.


In optional files, I have also included Brunette Claire sprite/portraits for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4399]Xtardew Valley.[/url] The files can be replaced the same way. 


All artistic credit goes to the original mod artists, Poltergeister for all of the gorgeous SVE and Seasonal portraits/sprites and Pseudodiego and Stanloona420 (Xtardew Valley). Please support those developers! I just wanted to share my personal game edited images!
